verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents Alerts, Case, listing and import APIs, and its developer docs exist as a ReadMe project. However, that site is entirely password-gated, no OpenAPI spec is published at the probed paths, and no public interactive reference or runnable examples are evidenced. The axis applies to an API-bearing SaaS platform, but nothing shows the product delivers this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
